rules.requirement: Each night*, choose a player & a character they become (if not in play). If a Demon is made, deaths tonight are arbitrary.

assertingTests.name: the Pit-Hag replaces a character atomically (SNV-PITHAG-01)
the Pit-Hag choosing a character already in play records that nothing happens (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a Pit-Hag-created Demon does not take the Demon turn and its deaths are not Demon attacks (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a Pit-Hag step records no arbitrary death until the host creates a Demon (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a Pit-Hag death marked under the earlier ruleset keeps its death (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a player the Pit-Hag makes the Town Crier wakes in its slot and one made the Clockmaker wakes at once (INFO-006, SNV-PITHAG-01)
a character created mid-game gains its start-knowing information that night (INFO-006, ROLE-PITHAG-003, SNV-PITHAG-01)
the Pit-Hag turns a player into a character not in play, does nothing for one in play, and fails while poisoned (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a Demon the Pit-Hag makes does not wake tonight, and the host marks the night's deaths on the Pit-Hag's step (SNV-PITHAG-01)
a healthy Pit-Hag replaces the player's character when it is not in play, and nothing happens otherwise (SNV-PITHAG-01)
